# SaltWatch Card 0.6.0

Great news: SaltWatch Card now works with other water-softener integrations
while keeping the existing automatic SaltWatch setup unchanged.

## What changed

- Added a **Data source** choice to the graphical editor.
- Kept **SaltWatch device** as the automatic, rename-safe discovery path.
- Added **Other device** for mapping entities from another Home Assistant
  water-softener integration.
- Made only the numeric salt-level entity required for other devices.
- Added optional mappings for the low-salt threshold, device status, estimated
  days until low salt, forecast status, and forecast details.
- Added a fixed low-salt threshold that defaults to 20% when no threshold
  entity is available.
- Derived Good and Low salt states automatically when no status entity is
  mapped.
- Hidden forecast choices when no forecast entity is mapped.
- Directed the default more-info action to the mapped salt-level entity.
- Added English and German editor copy and expanded the configuration guide.

## Compatibility

- Existing SaltWatch configurations using only `device_id` continue to work
  without changes.
- Selecting **SaltWatch device** continues to discover and validate all six
  official SaltWatch entities.
- Manual YAML configurations infer the entity-mapping source when
  `level_entity` is present, so `source: entities` is optional.
- Automatic discovery remains strict and still requires the latest official
  SaltWatch firmware.

## Validation

- 53 unit tests passed, including dedicated automatic-discovery and manual
  entity-mapping scenarios.
- 45 browser tests passed across desktop and mobile profiles; one desktop-only
  mobile-scroll test was skipped as intended.
- The production TypeScript and Vite build passed.
